goal: Let RPC callers optionally receive feerates in sat/vB instead of BTC/kvB
Spares downstream tools manual conversion arithmetic and precision loss at low feerates
agreement: Strong support for adding sat/vB outputs while preserving existing defaults
Tested and confirmed sat_vb works as expected across calls (musaHaruna)
Verified useful and confirmed cleanups were incorporated (willcl-ark)
Resolved prior concerns about precision, defaults, and API compatibility (maflcko, glozow, w0xlt)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because downstream tools and wallets almost universally operate in sat/vB
Eliminates client-side math and rounding bugs in sub-1 sat/vB environments
Making it optional leaves existing RPC integrations undisturbed
